subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should ClawHub publish this OpenClaw registry export bridge as a root `clawhub-schema` API now, and should it target hosted catalog feeds, account/publisher feeds, or both?
rationale: The code is a new public schema contract adjacent to an open feed API PR, and the spec still lists open questions about the first OpenClaw review API and push/pull direction.

options.title: Confirm the bridge contract before merge
options.body: A maintainer approves the exported helper shape, its feed target, and its sequencing with the account/publisher feed work before the branch is rebased and merged.

options.title: Keep it internal until feed APIs settle
options.body: The helper can be narrowed or kept out of the root package export until the feed and OpenClaw review contracts stabilize.

options.title: Pause behind the account feed PR
options.body: Maintainers can wait for https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 to settle before deciding whether this bridge should remain separate.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bridge contract before merge
recommendation.body: A maintainer approves the exported helper shape, its feed target, and its sequencing with the account/publisher feed work before the branch is rebased and merged.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied by history to the current catalog feed contract and recent adjacent feed runtime work.
